about: styles-c1: Redefine Style (DOM path) from a shape, and what styles based on the redefined one take; measured 2026-10-31. Since 2026-11-08 only the case whose object does not carry the redefined style stays here (the panel menu redefines the applied style, so this is not reachable from the panel); the five cases with the style applied were measured again through the real panel menu (objstyle-anchor-c1-redefine-menu.json, fixture objectstyles2).
